issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: WizardNote
products.tagline: Voice notes your phone transcribes, saved as markdown
products.summaryZh: 手机转写的语音笔记，保存为 markdown 格式
products.descriptionZh: 语音笔记，音频永不外传。WizardNote 在手机上转写（Whisper，离线），学习你的用词，并在任何 AI 看到文本之前剥离邮箱、电话号码和地址（Pro 版增加姓名和公司）。摘要使用你选择的 AI：Apple Intelligence、Gemini Nano、你自己的服务器、你的 API 密钥，或我们的欧盟云。Pro 版将带任务和发言人的 Markdown 笔记保存到你的 Obsidian 库。无需账户。Pro 版为一次性付费。
products.description: Voice notes that never send your audio anywhere. WizardNote transcribes on your phone (Whisper, offline), learns your vocabulary, and strips emails, phone numbers and addresses before any AI sees the text (Pro adds names and companies). Summaries use the AI you pick: Apple Intelligence, Gemini Nano, your own server, your API key, or our EU cloud. Pro saves markdown notes with tasks and speakers to your Obsidian vault. No account. Pro is one-time.

products.name: Oxagen
products.tagline: Mission control for agents to share + maintain context
products.summaryZh: 代理任务控制中心，用于共享并维护上下文
products.descriptionZh: Oxagen 将每一次编码智能体运行与其背后的人员、工作、代码变更、成本和结果关联起来。工程团队利用这份记录来指挥智能体、共享经过验证的指令和工具、对智能体通过 Oxagen 执行的操作实施策略管控，并在下一项任务中做得更好。我们构建它，是为了让团队能看到其 AI 投入的真实回报，也是为了让优秀的工程师在智能体时代依然能做出卓越的工作。
products.description: Oxagen links every coding-agent run to the people, work, code changes, costs, and outcomes behind it. Engineering teams use that record to direct their agents, share proven instructions and tools, enforce policy on the actions agents take through Oxagen, and get better at the next task. We built it so teams can see real returns on their AI spend, and so great engineers can still do excellent work in the age of agents.

products.name: Offstage Cloud
products.tagline: On-demand macOS sandboxes for AI agents
products.summaryZh: 按需为AI代理提供macOS沙箱
products.descriptionZh: Offstage 为 AI 代理和 CI 提供按需的 macOS 沙盒。使用 Xcode 构建 iOS 和 Mac 应用，在模拟器中启动它们，或交给代理一个真实的桌面。按秒计费，无 24 小时最低消费。运行 10 分钟约花费 0.18 美元。
products.description: Offstage gives AI agents and CI an on-demand macOS sandbox. Build iOS and Mac apps with Xcode, launch them in the Simulator, or hand an agent a real desktop. Pay per second with no 24-hour minimum. A 10-minute run costs about $0.18.

products.name: AirWave
products.tagline: Internet radio, at home on every Apple device
products.summaryZh: 网络电台，在每台Apple设备上都能得心应手
products.descriptionZh: AirWave 将全球数千个电台汇聚于一款原生应用，支持 iPhone、iPad、Mac、Apple Watch、Apple TV 和 CarPlay。直播电台可回听长达 30 分钟，查看播放过的每一首歌曲，通过 10 段均衡器调整音效，并在 Mac 菜单栏中一键访问。无需账户，无广告，无追踪。收听免费。AirWave Pro 新增录音、Sonos、iCloud 同步、Last.fm、小组件以及 Apple Watch 和 Apple TV 应用，每年 $4.99。
products.description: AirWave brings thousands of radio stations from around the world to iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV and CarPlay in one native app. Rewind live radio up to 30 minutes, see every song that played, shape the sound with a 10-band EQ, and keep it one click away in your Mac menu bar. No account, no ads, no tracking. Listening is free. AirWave Pro adds recording, Sonos, iCloud sync, Last.fm, widgets and the Apple Watch and Apple TV apps for $4.99 a year.

products.name: Blendra
products.tagline: Record a flow once and get a Playwright test project you own
products.summaryZh: 录制一次流程，即可获得一个归你所有的 Playwright 测试项目。
products.descriptionZh: 在桌面版 Chrome 中录制流程，即可获得一个 Playwright 项目的端到端测试：规格文件、页面对象、定位器文件、测试数据和 GitHub Actions 工作流。每一步之后，勾选应用显示的内容（一条消息、一个 URL、一个标题）。每次勾选都是一次带真实值的检查。没有 LLM 编写代码：相同的录制，相同的输出。它可在你的 CI 中运行，无需 Blendra。在 Blendra 的云运行器上，失败的测试会获得基于规则的原因及证据。免费方案。7 天 Pro 试用，无需信用卡。
products.description: Record a flow in desktop Chrome and get end-to-end tests as a Playwright project: specs, page objects, locator files, test data and a GitHub Actions workflow. After each step, tick what your app showed (a message, a URL, a heading). Each tick is a check with the real value. No LLM writes the code: same recording, same output. It runs in your CI without Blendra. On Blendra's cloud runner, a failed test gets a rule-based cause with evidence. Free plan. 7-day Pro trial, no card.

products.name: Mode
products.tagline: Tell your phone what to do. Mode does it in your apps.
products.summaryZh: 告诉你的手机该做什么。Mode 在你的应用中执行。
products.descriptionZh: 说一声，手机就照做。“给Sam发消息说我会迟到，然后点我常喝的咖啡”：Mode会打开WhatsApp，发送消息，找到你的订单，并在付款前停下。它在现有应用内运行，会学习你的常用习惯，并告诉你执行结果。它运行在你自己的AI上（ChatGPT、Claude或OpenRouter），因此不会经过任何其他人的服务器。今天支持iPhone，接下来是Android。免费且开源。
products.description: Say it, and your phone does it. "Text Sam I'm late, then order my usual coffee": Mode opens WhatsApp, sends the message, finds your order and stops before paying. It works inside the apps you already have, learns your usuals, and tells you how it went. It runs on your own AI (ChatGPT, Claude or OpenRouter), so nothing goes through anyone else's servers. iPhone today, Android next. Free and open source.

products.name: GrowX
products.tagline: The posting agent for X creators who get paid
products.summaryZh: 为获得报酬的X创作者提供发布代理
products.descriptionZh: 当你的收益与曝光量挂钩时，停更一天就意味着损失。GrowX 学习你的写作方式，研究你所在领域的热门内容，每天早晨为你提供现成草稿。你保持稳定更新，保持自我风格，并且每条帖子都由你审核通过。
products.description: When your payouts follow your impressions, skipping a day costs money. GrowX learns how you write, studies what's working in your niche and hands you ready drafts each morning. You stay consistent, you stay you, and you approve every post.

products.name: TweakTick
products.tagline: Client feedback and sign-off on live sites, PDFs and video
products.summaryZh: 客户对线上网站、PDF和视频的反馈与签核
products.descriptionZh: TweakTick 是面向自由职业者和小型代理机构的客户反馈与签核工具。发送一个链接，客户即可在实时网站、图片、PDF 或视频上标注评论，无需账户，也无需安装任何东西。每个版本为一轮（V1、V2……）。客户通过电子邮件中的 6 位验证码进行批准，你会获得一份签核证书。可与 Slack、Jira、Asana、Trello、Linear、Todoist 等集成，另有 Chrome 扩展程序。提供免费方案，无需信用卡。付费方案每月 19 美元起。
products.description: TweakTick is client feedback and sign-off for freelancers and small agencies. Send one link. Clients pin comments on your live website, images, PDFs or video, with no account and nothing to install. Each version is a round (V1, V2...). The client approves with a 6-digit code from their email, and you get a sign-off certificate. Works with Slack, Jira, Asana, Trello, Linear, Todoist and more, plus a Chrome extension. Free plan, no card needed. Paid plans from $19/mo.

products.name: Quotify 2
products.tagline: Keep the words that move you.
products.summaryZh: 留住那些打动你的文字。
products.descriptionZh: Quotify 2 保存你喜爱的书籍、文章、播客、X 和 Instagram 帖子以及对话中的引文，并让它们重新出现在你的主屏幕和锁屏上。已为 iPhone Duo 做好准备。拍摄书页或电子阅读器屏幕，Smart Photo to Quote 会提取引文和作者。选择小组件显示哪些引文，并在 mcp.quotify.to 将你的引文连接到 Claude、Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Grok Bot 和 Muse 中的 AI 聊天。无需在应用中创建账户。
products.description: Quotify 2 keeps the quotes you love from books, articles, podcasts, X and Instagram posts, and conversations, and brings them back on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Ready for iPhone Duo. Snap a book page or e-reader screen and Smart Photo to Quote pulls the quote and author. Choose which quotes your widgets show, and connect your quotes to AI chats in Claude, Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok Bot and Muse at mcp.quotify.to. No account to create in the app.

products.name: TodoLot
products.tagline: Reminders that talk: say it once, it rings and says it
products.summaryZh: 会说话的提醒：说一次，它便响起并说出来
products.descriptionZh: 只需说一次待办事项。到了合适的时间，你的iPhone会像真正的闹钟一样响起，并大声说出任务内容，即使处于静音状态也不例外。AI能将一口气说的话拆分成多个独立任务，由你确认。拍一张票务照片，它也会变成一个闹钟。
products.description: Say your to-dos once. At the right time your iPhone rings like a real alarm and says the task out loud, even on silent. AI splits one breath of talking into separate tasks; you confirm. Snap a photo of a ticket and it becomes an alarm too.

products.name: MakerRadar
products.tagline: Indie products found on X, checked by a human
products.summaryZh: 在X上发现的独立产品，经人工审核
products.descriptionZh: 一个免费、由单一编辑维护的独立产品目录，产品均发现自 X。每条收录都会对照产品自身网站进行核实——没有投票，没有付费展示位，没有联盟链接。每周日精选五个，每个都附上推荐理由。
products.description: A free, one-editor directory of indie products found on X. Every listing is checked against the product's own website — no votes, no paid placement, no affiliate links. Five picks every Sunday, each with a reason why.

products.name: CodeSpace Hub
products.tagline: Manage GitHub Codespaces across your favorite IDEs
products.summaryZh: 在你喜欢的 IDE 中管理 GitHub Codespaces
products.descriptionZh: CodeSpace Hub（在扩展商店中列为 Antigravity Codespaces Pro）可帮助在兼容的基于 VS Code 的编辑器中管理 GitHub Codespaces。浏览已配置的账户、通过 SSH 连接、管理工作区、诊断设置问题并查看 GitHub 报告的使用情况。可选的 MCP 支持让 AI 代理运行远程命令。
products.description: CodeSpace Hub (listed in extension stores as Antigravity Codespaces Pro) helps manage GitHub Codespaces from compatible VS Code-based editors. Browse configured accounts, connect over SSH, manage workspaces, diagnose setup issues and review GitHub-reported usage. Optional MCP support lets AI agents run remote commands.

products.name: FolioBots
products.tagline: 58 AI agents debate stocks and trade virtual portfolios
products.summaryZh: 58个AI代理就股票展开辩论并交易虚拟投资组合
products.descriptionZh: FolioBots 是一项实时实验：58 个 AI 代理，各自拥有不同的投资策略（价值、股息、动量、逆向……），获得 10,000 欧元和 10,000 美元的虚拟资金。它们研究标普 500 和欧洲主要指数的公司，在公开论坛上互相辩论，并按真实市场价格买入或卖出，解释每一步操作。你只需观察谁胜出。免费，无需注册，支持 5 种语言。不构成财务建议。
products.description: FolioBots is a live experiment: 58 AI agents, each with its own investing strategy (value, dividends, momentum, contrarian…), get €10,000 and $10,000 in virtual money. They research companies from the S&P 500 and Europe's main indexes, argue with each other in a public forum and buy or sell at real market prices, explaining every move. You just watch who wins. Free, no sign-up, in 5 languages. Not financial advice.

products.name: My Box Map
products.tagline: Label boxes with QR codes and find anything fast
products.summaryZh: 用二维码标记箱子，快速找到任何物品
products.descriptionZh: 打开五个一模一样的箱子找手机充电器？My Box Map 会为每个箱子编号，贴上二维码标签并分配房间颜色，还能拍照并列出箱内物品。扫描箱子即可查看内容，或跨所有箱子搜索任意物品。专为搬家设计，也同样适用于车库、阁楼、地下室或储藏室。支持离线使用，无需账户，数据保留在你的 iPhone 上。支持七种语言。最多免费使用 5 个箱子，之后一次性购买。
products.description: Opening five identical boxes to find the phone charger? My Box Map numbers every box, gives it a QR label and a room colour, and lets you photograph and list what is inside. Scan a box to see its contents, or search any item across all boxes. Made for moving house, and just as handy for the garage, attic, basement or storage room. Works offline, no account, data stays on your iPhone. Seven languages. Free up to 5 boxes, then a one-time purchase.

products.name: Our Kev
products.tagline: Mileage, expenses and invoices for UK tradespeople
products.summaryZh: 英国技工的行车里程、费用和发票
products.descriptionZh: 我们的Kev为英国技工在手机上处理文书工作。按HMRC费率通过GPS记录里程，记录费用和工时，发送报价和发票链接，保存CIS报表并持续估算CIS退税，查看需预留多少税款。免费计划永久免费。Pro每月7.99英镑，含14天免费试用，增加收据读取、无限发票和报价以及付款提醒功能。
products.description: Our Kev does the paperwork for UK tradespeople, from a phone. Track mileage by GPS at HMRC rates, log expenses and hours, send quotes and invoice links, keep your CIS statements with a running CIS refund estimate, and see how much tax to put aside. The free plan is free for good. Pro is £7.99 a month with 14 days free, and adds receipt reading, unlimited invoices and quotes, and payment reminders.

products.name: Sweepcut
products.tagline: On-device batch background remover for Mac
products.summaryZh: Mac 设备端批量背景移除工具
products.descriptionZh: 把文件夹拖进来，Sweepcut 就会用 Apple 的 Vision 模型裁出你 Mac 上的每一张照片，然后按 Etsy、Shopify、Amazon 或 eBay 的尺寸要求逐一导出。无需上传，无需账户，无需订阅。一次性付费 19 美元。
products.description: Drop in a folder and Sweepcut cuts out every photo on your Mac with Apple's Vision model, then exports each one sized for Etsy, Shopify, Amazon or eBay. No uploads, no account, no subscription. $19 once.

products.name: coupehub
products.tagline: The booking app for barbershops
products.summaryZh: 理发店预约应用
products.descriptionZh: 顾客通过你的Instagram链接预约，并可选择在WhatsApp上接收提醒。你可以一眼看清全天的安排。每个地点每月30欧元。
products.description: Customers book from your Instagram link and get a reminder, on WhatsApp if they like. You see your whole day at a glance. €30 per location a month.

products.name: BuyerCue
products.tagline: Find SaaS prospects with evidence of growth investment
products.summaryZh: 寻找有增长投资证据的SaaS潜在客户
products.descriptionZh: 寻找值得在联系前调研的SaaS公司。BuyerCue将来源明确、标注日期的增长信号与产品背景及公开业务联系方式相结合。免费搜索，查看证据，然后解锁你选定的公司。新账户获赠五个免费令牌；一个令牌解锁一家公司。可在网站上操作，或连接你的AI助手。每条消息均由你审核并发送。
products.description: Find SaaS companies worth researching before you reach out. BuyerCue combines sourced, dated growth signals with product context and public business contact routes. Search for free, inspect the evidence, then unlock the companies you choose. New accounts get five free tokens; one token unlocks one company. Work on the website or connect your AI assistant. You review and send every message.

products.name: Passby: Location Reminders
products.tagline: Lock-screen arrival alerts for couples. Zero battery drain
products.summaryZh: 情侣锁屏到达提醒。零电量消耗
products.descriptionZh: 当你经过已保存的地点时，锁屏会立即提醒。与伴侣共享位置标记，一键勾选待办事项，且不耗电。
products.description: Lock-screen arrival alerts the second you walk past a saved spot. Share pins with your partner, check off errands in 1 tap, with zero battery drain.

products.name: Dunnit Daily
products.tagline: Daily murder mystery: 4 suspects, 6 clues, 1 killer
products.summaryZh: 每日谋杀谜案：4名嫌疑人，6条线索，1名凶手
products.descriptionZh: 一款每日推理游戏。每天早上更新一个案件：查看4名嫌疑人，用点数最多购买6条线索，然后指认凶手及其动机。初始有1,000点——线索和计时都会消耗点数。免费，无需账户，含连续游玩记录和案件存档。
products.description: A daily deduction game. A new case each morning: review 4 suspects, spend points on up to 6 clues, then accuse the killer and their motive. Start with 1,000 points — clues and the clock cost you. Free, no account, with streaks and an archive.
